About Handpan Chords

A free chord and progression practice tool for your own handpan scale.

How it works

  1. Pick a built-in scale, or type your own.
  2. Flip a card to see the chord lit on the pan.
  3. Open the settings menu and switch to Chord progression for a sequence to play.

Try these scales

  • D Kurd 10: 49 chord cards
  • D Amara 10 (D Celtic): 29 chord cards
  • D Amara 9 (D Celtic): 27 chord cards
  • F3 Low Pygmy 18: 53 chord cards
  • C# Hijaz 9: 19 chord cards

Add your own scale

Type any scale and the app generates its chords.

Privacy

Your scales stay in this browser on this device. Nothing is published, and no one else can see them. To use a scale on another device or send it to a friend, tap the link icon at the top of the screen and share the link. Opening it adds the scale to that browser, and it stays there. The site counts anonymous visits and feature use with Google Analytics, without cookies in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland.
